label: Sampled coverage
subgoals: Draw a uniform random sample from the full fault list
Report detected over sampled as the estimate

label: Confidence
subgoals: Compute the standard deviation from p and n
Multiply by 1.96 for the 95 percent half-width
Shrink the half-width by sampling more faults

label: When to recurse
subgoals: Solve the half-width formula for the sample size
Recurse to full simulation when candidates differ by less than twice the half-width
Let the harness draw the sampling seed
